identity.what_it_is: The shared identity layer that every subsequent Felly Club capability depends on. Creates three authenticated personas (mentee, mentor, admin), an admin-curated mentor onboarding pipeline with verification, and the profile infrastructure that carries trust signals throughout the platform.
identity.what_it_is_not: This is not the mentor discovery marketplace (E2), session booking system (E3), or payment processor (E4). It creates the verified users those systems operate on.
core_jobs: Allow mentees to self-register and manage their profiles
Allow administrators to onboard, verify, and manage mentors
Enforce role-based access control across all three personas
Provide the verified identity foundation for all downstream features

invariants.description: A mentor profile is never visible to mentees until an administrator has explicitly approved it
Every authenticated request is associated with exactly one role — Mentee, Mentor, or Admin — and a user cannot hold multiple roles simultaneously
A verified badge is only assigned by an administrator after reviewing verification artefacts — it can never be self-assigned
Email addresses are unique across all user accounts — no two users can register with the same email
A user's password is never stored in readable form and is never included in any API response, log entry, or notification

in_scope: Mentee self-registration via email and password
Mentee self-registration via social login (Google, Apple)
Authenticated login for all three personas
Password reset and recovery via email link
Admin-driven mentor onboarding with bio, expertise category, pricing, availability, verification artefacts
Admin verification review queue with approve/reject actions
Verified badge assignment upon admin approval
Mentee profile: view and edit name, email, interests, goals, avatar
Mentor profile: view and edit bio, expertise categories, pricing, availability, photo
Admin user list with status filters
Role-based access control enforcing Mentee, Mentor, and Admin boundaries
Session token management with automatic expiry and refresh
Mentor profile status lifecycle: Draft → Pending Verification → Verified / Rejected
out_of_scope: Bulk user import or directory sync
User analytics dashboards or detailed audit trail
Social login providers beyond Google and Apple

features.name: Mentee Registration
features.description: A new visitor can create a mentee account using either email-and-password or social login (Google, Apple). After registration, the mentee receives an email verification link. Upon verification, the mentee lands on their dashboard with prompts to complete their profile.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: All three personas can log in using their credentials. The system issues a short-lived session token upon successful authentication and supports automatic token refresh. Failed login attempts are rate-limited.

features.name: Password Reset & Recovery
features.description: A user who has forgotten their password can request a reset link via email. The link is time-limited and single-use. After setting a new password, all existing sessions are invalidated.

features.name: Admin-Driven Mentor Onboarding
features.description: Platform administrators create mentor profiles through a guided workflow capturing bio, expertise category, pricing, availability, profile photo, and verification artefacts. The mentor profile starts in Draft status and moves to Pending Verification when submitted.

features.name: Mentor Verification & Badge Assignment
features.description: Administrators review pending mentor profiles, inspect verification artefacts, and approve or reject each profile. Approved mentors receive a verified badge and login credentials. Rejected profiles can be re-submitted after corrections.

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: Mentees and mentors can view and edit their own profiles. Both see a profile completeness indicator showing which fields are filled and which are missing.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: The platform enforces strict separation between the three personas. Every API endpoint and page is protected by role-based guards. Administrators have read-only visibility into mentee and mentor data for operational purposes.
